name: Elyndor Inspired by Roja Elysium | Fresh Luxury Men’s Perfume
description: Elyndor, inspired by the premium Roja Elysium, is a bright, fresh, and luxurious men’s fragrance designed for those who appreciate crisp citrus and refined sophistication. It opens with an invigorating burst of grapefruit, bergamot, and lemon—instantly refreshing and energizing. The heart features aromatic juniper berry, vetiver, and soft floral nuances that add smoothness and elegance. Finally, a base of ambergris, cedarwood, and musk creates a clean, long-lasting, masculine finish that feels modern and effortlessly classy. With a high concentration of perfume oils, Elyndor offers excellent longevity and projection for a fresh fragrance—making it ideal for daytime wear, office use, gym freshness, and summer seasons. If you love clean, uplifting scents with a premium touch, Elyndor captures the essence of Roja Elysium at an accessible price, exclusively at Scents by Aamir. Features Top Notes: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Lemon Heart Notes: Juniper Berry, Vetiver, Floral Accords Base Notes: Ambergris, Musk, Cedarwood Longevity: 6–8 hours (Long-Lasting for a fresh scent) Occasion: Perfect for office, gym, daytime wear, and summer seasons Why Choose Elyndor? story: Elyndor, inspired by Roja Elysium, features refreshing citrus notes blended with juniper berry, vetiver, and ambergris for a clean, luxurious, and long-lasting men’s fragrance.
